name: m2734-sufra
prompt: Cinematic vertical 9:16 photoreal, 7th-century Arabia, bright clear morning. Top-down view of a simple meal laid on a woven palm-leaf mat on clean sand: round flat breads, a wooden bowl of glossy dates, a clay bowl of white milk, a small clay water jug and a clay cup. Two anonymous RIGHT hands in plain undyed period sleeves reach in from the bottom edge - no faces, no heads, no left hands. Soft even daylight, short gentle shadows, vibrant warm saturated colours, inviting and calm, no modern objects, no text.
